title: Firefox password key store
whyItMatters: This file holds the keys that decrypt the saved passwords in logins.json. Copy it with logins.json and the saved passwords can be recovered on another machine.
source: Mozilla Support, profiles where Firefox stores user data (key4.db): https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profiles-where-firefox-stores-user-data
notes: If the user set a Primary Password, the keys are additionally protected by it and cannot be used without it. Pair rule: browser.firefox.logins.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Firefox, open Settings > Privacy & Security > Logins and Passwords and export your saved logins to a file you keep.
cleanup.signOut: In Firefox, open the account menu and sign out of your Mozilla account, so the profile stops syncing with it.
steps: In Firefox, remove the saved logins you no longer need from Logins and Passwords.
Delete the key file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: The key file cannot be restored once removed; any saved login not exported becomes unreadable, even if the login file is kept.
cleanup.source: Mozilla Support, Password Manager - Remember, delete and edit logins and passwords in Firefox: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/password-manager-remember-delete-edit-logins
